segments.ja: オルブドのあと、軍はヒストリアを壁の王として立てます。立てる儀式は、旗と人の列です。列の中で、彼女はクリスタのドレスではなく、自分の名で歩きます。歩く先に、王冠があります。王冠を、ロッドは沈黙する神の道具にしようとしました。しようとした道具を、彼女は見える王の印に変えます。変える朝が、この回です。回の下で、人は新しい顔を覚えます。
segments.en: After Orvud, the military sets Historia up as ruler of the walls. The ritual of setting her up is flags and a line of people. In the line, she walks not in Christa's dress but in her own name. Ahead of the walk is a crown. Rod tried to make the crown a tool of a silent god. She changes the tool he tried to make into the mark of a ruler who can be seen. The morning of the change is this episode. Under the episode, people learn a new face.

segments.ja: 戴冠の場で、ヒストリアはリヴァイの顔を殴ります。殴る理由は、命令で頭を下げろと言われたことへの返事です。返事は、女王は兵長の道具ではない、です。です、という拳を、周囲は凍ります。凍った空気を、リヴァイは鼻血で受け、そして認めます。認めることが、二人の契約です。契約は、彼女が本当に王であるなら、調査を止めるな、です。止めるな、の先に地下室があります。
segments.en: At the crowning, Historia hits Levi's face. The reason she hits it is a reply to being told to lower her head on command. The reply is that a queen is not the Captain's tool. The people around freeze at the fist that says so. Levi receives the frozen air with a nosebleed, and then he accepts it. Accepting is the contract between the two. The contract is: if she is truly ruler, do not stop the survey. Ahead of do not stop is the basement.

segments.ja: ヒストリアの統治は、畑に出ることから始まります。始まる姿を、人は旗の奥の王より近く感じます。近く感じることが、支持です。支持は、レイスの血の恐怖を、働く顔で薄めます。薄めた支持を、エルヴィンは遠征の許可に変えます。変える許可は、ウォール・マリアの穴を目指す軍です。軍の理由を、彼女は自分の言葉で街に説明します。説明する女王は、沈黙しません。王冠の前で、列は一度呼吸を揃えます。揃えた呼吸が、次の言葉を待ちます。
segments.en: Historia's rule starts with going out into the fields. People feel the figure that starts nearer than a king behind a flag. Feeling nearer is support. The support thins the fear of Reiss blood with a face that works. Erwin turns the thinned support into permission for an expedition. The permission he turns it into is an army that aims at the hole in Wall Maria. She explains the army's reason to the city in her own words. The queen who explains does not go silent. In front of the crown, the line matches its breath once. The matched breath waits for the next words.

segments.ja: エレンは、女王の前で地下室の鍵を見せます。見せる鍵は、父の罪の残りです。残りを、彼は秘密のままシガンシナへ持っていく必要はありません。ない必要を、ヒストリアは公の目標にします。目標は、家を開け、壁の外の無知を減らす、です。減らす旅に、軍を出すことが彼女の最初の大きな命令です。命令は、父の器とは逆方向です。逆方向を、彼女は自分で選びます。
segments.en: In front of the queen, Eren shows the key to the basement. The key he shows is the remainder of his father's sin. He does not need to carry the remainder to Shiganshina still as a secret. Historia makes the need that is not there into a public goal. The goal is to open the house and reduce the ignorance outside the walls. Sending the army on the journey that reduces it is her first large order. The order is the opposite direction from her father's vessel. She chooses the opposite direction herself.

segments.ja: 戴冠の喧騒の外で、ケニーは傷を抱えています。抱えた傷は、洞窟の崩落とその後の散りです。散った彼は、力を得られなかった事実と一緒に座ります。座る場所は、王家の友だった記憶の近くです。近くで、彼はリヴァイに渡すものをまだポケットに持っています。持っているものは、後の注射です。注射を、今日の女王の朝はまだ知りません。知らないまま、街は祝っています。
segments.en: Outside the noise of the crowning, Kenny is holding a wound. The wound he holds is the cave's collapse and the scattering after it. He, who scattered, sits together with the fact that he did not obtain the power. The place he sits is near the memory of having been a friend of the royal house. Near it, he still has in his pocket something to pass to Levi. The thing he has is a later injection. The queen's morning today does not yet know the injection. Without knowing, the city is celebrating.

segments.en: The Levi squad receives the queen's order with the number reduced by guns. The order they receive is to become the core of the next expedition. Jean, Sasha, Connie, Mikasa, and Armin remain in the core. The faces that remain are the faces that were cleaning the house at Trost. The ordinary day they were in does not return. segments.ja: 壁の王の仕事は、巨人を黙って祈ることではありません。人の前で食べ、働き、軍を出すことです。出す軍が、偽りの平和を終わらせるかもしれません。かもしれません、という危険を、ヒストリアは隠しません。隠さない演説が、オルブドで名を言った声の続きです。続きを、貴族の何人かは恐れます。恐れる貴族より、通りの人の支持が今日は重いです。重い支持が、王冠を安定させます。
segments.en: The work of the ruler of the walls is not to pray silently at Titans. It is to eat in front of people, to work, and to send an army. The army she sends may end a false peace. Historia does not hide the danger of that may. The speech that does not hide is the continuation of the voice that said her name at Orvud. Some nobles fear the continuation. Heavier today than the nobles who fear is the support of the people of the street. The heavy support steadies the crown.

segments.en: Erwin uses the queen's permission for the expedition of the basement. The face that uses it is a face whose bet won once. Next after the bet that won is Wall Maria. Even after it arrives, nobody stands up from a seat.

vocab.exampleEn: After Orvud, the military sets Historia up as ruler of the walls. The ritual of setting her up is flags and a line of people. She changes the tool he tried to make into the mark of a ruler who can be seen. The morning of the change is this episode. Under the episode, people learn a new face.
